newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia 7-mo industrial output falls 2.0 pct - poll.
newsitem.headline: Colombia 7-mo industrial output falls 2.0 pct - poll.

text.p: Industrial production fell 2.0 percent in Colombia in the first seven months of 1996 from the same period last year, according to a leading survey of national business conditions.

The closely watched survey by the National Association of Industrialists said sales by the manufacturing sector dropped 1.5 percent during the same year-on-year period and that industrial capacity use averaged 76.3 percent between January and July 1996, its lowest level this decade.
Industrialists participating in the nationwide survey cited "insecurity" and the country's war with leftist guerrillas as the top problem affecting business activity.

The political crisis stemming from charges that President Ernesto Samper's 1994 election campaign was partly financed by drug lords was considered the second biggest obstacle to profitability, with eight out of 10 participants saying it had adversely affected their businesses.
